label: Pediatric syncope in the emergency department: a risk-stratified diagnostic and disposition pathway.
summary: BACKGROUND: Pediatric syncope accounts for 1–3% of emergency department (ED) visits. Although most cases are benign, 4% are caused by cardiac disease and 3% by seizures, which carry a risk of sudden death or neurologic injury if missed. Vasovagal syncope accounts for 52–74% of cases and postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome (POTS) for approximately 13%.
